meta.name: gget
meta.description: Fast CLI/Python queries to 20+ bioinformatics databases. Use for quick lookups: gene info, BLAST/BLAT, viral sequence downloads, AlphaFold structures, enrichment analysis, OpenTargets, COSMIC, CELLxGENE, and 8cube mouse specificity/expression data. Best for interactive exploration and simple queries. For batch processing or advanced BLAST use biopython; for multi-database Python workflows use bioservices.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 快速查询20多个生物信息学数据库，获取基因、蛋白和序列信息
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要从多个生物数据库快速获取基因或蛋白质信息
copy.tagline_en: Quickly query 20+ bioinformatics databases for gene, protein, and sequence info
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need fast lookups of gene or protein data across multiple biological databases

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以快速查询 20 多个生物信息学数据库，例如获取基因信息、比对序列（BLAST/BLAT）、下载病毒序列、预测蛋白质结构（AlphaFold）、做富集分析等。
howto.when: 当你提出与基因、序列、蛋白质、表达数据或疾病相关的问题时，Claude 会使用此技能进行快速查询。

say.text: 查询人类ACE2基因的详细信息。
将这段蛋白质序列做BLAST比对：MKWMFKEDHS...
用 AlphaFold 预测序列 MKWMFKEDHS... 的结构。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can quickly query 20+ bioinformatics databases, e.g., retrieve gene info, perform BLAST/BLAT searches, download viral sequences, predict protein structures via AlphaFold, and run enrichment analysis.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask questions about genes, sequences, proteins, expression data, or diseases, suitable for quick lookups.

say_en.text: Get detailed info on human ACE2 gene.
say_en.note: Calls gget info to retrieve data from Ensembl, UniProt, etc.
Calls gget blast against nr or swissprot.

say_en.text: Predict structure of MKWMFKEDHS... with AlphaFold.
say_en.note: Requires prior setup: gget setup alphafold, then gget alphafold.
